name: Tiangong-1
tagline: First Chinese space station; single-module testbed
description: Tiangong-1 is a space station built by CAST in China. First Chinese space station; single-module testbed. Launched in 2011, hosted two crewed visits (Shenzhou 9 in 2012 and Shenzhou 10 in 2013); contact lost March 2016 and reentered uncontrolled April 2, 2018.
best_known_for: First Chinese space station; single-module testbed
